files.label: vulnerable
files.intendedBehavior: Merges default configuration with user payload.

securityGroundTruth.flawType: CWE-1321: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
securityGroundTruth.rationale: Mutates target defaultConfig object directly with userPayload using Object.assign. If userPayload contains an own __proto__ property, prototype pollution occurs on the target prototype chain.

threatModelAndAssumptions.trustBoundary: userPayload represents an untrusted JSON object received from an external caller, API response, or user input.
threatModelAndAssumptions.attackerControlledInput: userPayload containing an own __proto__ property (e.g. parsed from JSON data) holding injected properties.
threatModelAndAssumptions.executionEnvironment: JavaScript client runtime executing Object.assign on mutable application configuration object.
threatModelAndAssumptions.impactSupportingSeverity: MEDIUM severity: Mutating the prototype chain of defaultConfig affects downstream prototype-sensitive property lookups across components sharing that object structure, potentially overriding settings or altering execution logic if suitable gadgets exist.
threatModelAndAssumptions.safePartnerAssumptions: C-A8-049.js assumes defaultConfig represents trusted baseline properties and userPayload is plain JSON data without hostile getters. sanitizeInputProperties filters dangerous property keys (__proto__, constructor, prototype) and Object.assign({}, ...) merges into a fresh empty object, preventing mutation of defaultConfig.

expectedScannerFindings.weaknessDescription: Unsafe use of Object.assign() mutating target object.
